card.name: Start of toxin-related medical words
card.fires_on: The first piece of a long word that is about to become a toxin or poisoning term, such as antitoxin, intoxication, neurotoxicity or nephrotoxic. It marks the spot just before the "toxic" part.

modes.description: The neuro or nephro part just before "toxicity" or "toxic".

card.writes: It lowers the odds of toxic, toxicity and poison words coming next, so it is mainly a suppressing effect.
card.plain: It fires on the opening bit of words like antitoxin, intoxication and nephrotoxic, just before the toxic part.
